basis.method: Classify each value-vector case by the source named in its rule/provenance text. tradingview.com URLs count as live-doc-cited. Snapshot/signature/manual-index mentions count as snapshot-cited. Missing rule text is local-formula-no-citation, not snapshot-derived. The math.clamp local extension is separate because it is not an official TradingView member.
basis.limit: This classifies recorded oracle source metadata. Local-formula-no-citation cases are independent of the engine and do not cite the committed reference snapshot, but their live documentation citation is not recorded per case.

notes: run-pine-value-vectors.ts imports pineV6ReferenceManualBuiltinNames() to validate officialMembers and compute coverage denominators.
The committed snapshot affects member-name acceptance and coverage accounting, not the expected value formulas for the 905 passing vector cases.
